policy: Repository automation proves control implementation; only retained production-like execution and accountable approval can close external gates.

suites.name: End-to-end workflow and maker-checker UAT
suites.required_external_evidence: Named business-user scripts, results, exceptions and signatures

suites.name: Journal balance, stock conservation, subledger controls and reversals
suites.required_external_evidence: Production-like migration and UAT reconciliation signed by Finance and Inventory

suites.name: Tenant, company, branch, warehouse, payroll and sensitive-finance isolation
suites.required_external_evidence: Production identity and authorization test results plus independent penetration test

suites.name: Idempotency, duplicate sync, concurrency, ambiguous response and retry
suites.required_external_evidence: Production-like concurrency and connector fault-injection results

suites.name: Closed periods, effective dates, currency and timezone boundaries
suites.required_external_evidence: Finance-approved boundary cases using approved statutory configuration

suites.name: Integration outage, replay, dead-letter and reconciliation
suites.required_external_evidence: Certified provider sandbox and production-like outage/replay results

suites.name: Accessibility, bilingual, printing and Android device matrix
suites.required_external_evidence: Human accessibility review, English/Swahili review, physical printers and approved Android device matrix

suites.name: Load, soak, dependency, restore and disaster recovery
suites.required_external_evidence: Production-like retained results against approved SLO, RPO and RTO

suites.name: Payroll parallel and statutory/accounting reconciliation
suites.required_external_evidence: Two approved payroll parallel runs and Tanzanian professional sign-off

suites.name: Two complete migration rehearsals and opening reconciliation
suites.required_external_evidence: Two distinct PRODUCTION_TRIAL batches, ten passing reconciliation domains and accountable signatures
